```
FUNCTION_BLOCK AlarmHandling
VAR_INPUT
    Value : REAL;
    hiLevel : REAL;
    loLevel : REAL;
    hystWindow : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    hiAlarm : BOOL;
    loAlarm : BOOL;
    error : BOOL;
    status : WORD;
END_VAR
VAR
END_VAR

(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT ... *)
(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)

IF loLevel >= hiLevel THEN
    error := TRUE;
    status := WORD#16#8001;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel) THEN
    error := TRUE;
    status := WORD#16#8002;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

error := FALSE;
status := WORD#16#0000;

IF hiAlarm THEN
    IF Value < (hiLevel - hystWindow) THEN
         hiAlarm := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF Value > hiLevel THEN
         hiAlarm := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF loAlarm THEN
    IF Value > (loLevel + hystWindow) THEN
         loAlarm := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF Value < loLevel THEN
         loAlarm := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
```
